diagnosticBoundary: Causal contrast 1.05 -> 1 -> 1.05 experiment on the original material and lighting. The hypothesis is that post-linear contrast can clip dark source signal; no conclusion is inferred from successful loading or renderOk. Selected original/neutral/restored second-frame images and full linear readback/capture records are preserved. Neutral contrast is a diagnostic state, not an authorized global grade fix or visual acceptance.
